market_day.name: Market Day
market_day.description: Townsfolk come shopping in crowds, and there are extra orders.

fishing_season.name: Fishing Season
fishing_season.description: Townsfolk want boats and fishing rods, and pay double for them.

railway_week.name: Railway Week
railway_week.description: Lay a rail line from the town square to the neighborhood. $40 when it connects.

harvest_festival.name: Harvest Festival
harvest_festival.description: Farm orders pay double, and the town wants pumpkin pie.

town_feast.name: Town Feast
town_feast.description: The town wants a feast: big food orders. $10 for whoever fills the most.

tourist_day.name: Tourist Day
tourist_day.description: Tourists wait at the Taxi Stand. Each one taken to a shop buys two things there.

rainy_day_rides.name: Rainy Day Rides
rainy_day_rides.description: Nobody wants to walk in the rain. Passenger orders pay double.

book_fair.name: Book Fair
book_fair.description: Townsfolk buy written books, and there are book orders. The host picks the best story.

treasure_hunt.name: Treasure Hunt
treasure_hunt.description: A treasure chest is buried near town. Follow the clues in the news!

grand_opening.name: Grand Opening
grand_opening.description: A new shop opened! It gets extra townsfolk visits today.

big_sale_day.name: Big Sale Day
big_sale_day.description: Double townsfolk visits to shops priced at or below value.

construction_boom.name: Construction Boom
construction_boom.description: Fill the marked area at the town square with blocks. $30 to share.

storm_repairs.name: Storm Repairs
storm_repairs.description: The storm knocked down fences and lanterns at the square. $3 for each one put back.

interest_day.name: Interest Day
interest_day.description: Money saved at the bank today earns double interest.

election_day.name: Election Day
election_day.description: Run for Mayor with /mayor run, and vote with /vote. Voting closes at the end of the day.

holiday.name: Holiday
holiday.description: The Mayor declared a holiday! $5 for everyone, and fireworks at the square.

night_market.name: Night Market
night_market.description: Full moon! Shops with a lantern or torch by the sign get double visits.

lost_pet.name: Lost Pet
lost_pet.description: Whiskers the cat is lost! Bring her back to the town square.

shop_inspector.name: Shop Inspector
shop_inspector.description: An inspector checks every shop. Full stock and fair prices earn $10.

contest.name: Contest
contest.description: The host has started a contest!
